description: The contract of an operation of the delivery gate that runs the test suite (unit, mutation testing), whose tests start servers on a port of the loopback and call them: the loopback, and nothing outside the machine. On macOS the loopback is every local port, so a service of the host that listens on localhost is reachable; on Linux it is the sandbox's own. It works on a copy of the committed tree, in the directory of the run, which is the only place it writes: the tree that is judged, the git directory, the gate and the settings are read-only to it, and the directory the sandbox runtime shares between its sandboxes is denied. It reads the directory of the run, the files of the gate that judges and the tools, and nothing else of the user's home. Variables: ${home}, ${run} (created for this run of the gate, removed after it: the copy in tree/, tmp/, home/), ${launcher} (the directory of the gate that judges), ${toolchain} (inside the home: the directories of PATH, the one of node and the packages installed beside it, and the real directory of each program a check starts).
